name: Krynn (V2): Shadows of the Lance (351 AC)
campaignName: Krynn (V2): Shadows of the Lance (351 AC)
description: Start in Autumn 351 AC as a custom non-canonical cohort while the Heroes of the Lance move across Ansalon as Autonomous NPCs driven by the 12-tick Companion Odyssey Clock (TRK_COMPANIONS_ODYSSEY). Features the Tri-Vector Allegiance Sandbox (aid the Heroes' flanks, race them as Conclave/Freebooter rivals, or hunt and intercept them as Dragonarmy Highlord operatives) plus 2 Relic & Locus Memory Crucible Quests into 346–347 AC.

nodes.name: Solace (The Valleys of the Trees)
nodes.displayName: Solace & Inn of the Last Home
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Colossal autumnal vallenwood trees cradling buildings in gold-and-scarlet boughs; suspended rope walkways creaking forty feet above leaf-mulched earth; cast-iron skillets sizzling with Otik's spiced potatoes.
- *Behaviors:* Townsfolk ascending rope ladders at dusk; hooded strangers checking satchels at the crossroads.
- *Relationships:* Deep tavern kinship around [[NPC:npc_otik]] and [[NPC:npc_tika]] strained by [[NPC:npc_hederick]]'s Seeker inquisition.
- *Attitudes:* Nostalgic warmth colliding with post-Cataclysm cynicism toward the old gods.
- *Values:* Hospitality of the hearth versus theocratic conformity.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_solace_inn]]. Connected to [[Node:N_HAVEN]], [[Node:N_CRYSTALMIR]], and [[Node:N_PAX_THARKAS]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: High Theocrat Hederick and Fewmaster Toede patrol the elevated boardwalks hunting the Blue Crystal Staff.

partyRapport.notes: Home sanctuary of the Companions at Otik Sandath's Inn of the Last Home.

nodes.name: Haven (Seat of the High Seekers)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Whitewashed stone villas, cobble squares smelling of tallow candles, flash-powder sulfur from Belzor's shrine, and wet wool.
- *Behaviors:* Seeker magistrates weighing steel coins; apprentices reciting rote cantrips under [[NPC:npc_theobald]].
- *Relationships:* [[NPC:npc_antimodes]] secretly funding [[NPC:npc_raistlin]]'s schooling while [[NPC:npc_widow_judith]] stirs fanaticism.
- *Attitudes:* Complacent mercantile piety masking cowardly appeasement of [[Faction:fac_red_dragonarmy]].
- *Values:* Respectability, coin, and dogmatic orthodoxy.

minorities.name: Seeker Clerisy & Sellswords
minorities.traits: Tax collectors, charlatan priests, and Master Theobald's school

demographics.social_friction_notes: In 344-346 AC, Widow Judith's Belzor cult and Master Theobald's mediocre magic school dominate the stone squares.

partyRapport.notes: Bureaucratic Seeker capital; Antimodes maintains a suite at the Whitestone Inn.

nodes.name: Crystalmir Lake & Queer Idol Shore
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Cold mirror-dark alpine water reflecting autumn vallenwoods; the soot-blackened stone idol where [[NPC:npc_goldmoon]]'s [[Item:ITM-BLUE-STAFF]] blazes against [[NPC:npc_toede]]'s goblin ambush.
- *Behaviors:* Ferrymen poling flatboats through morning mist; Baaz draconians turning to crumbling stone when slain.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Darken Wood (Domain of the Forestmaster)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Ancient, lightless canopy smelling of crushed wintergreen, ozone, and centuries-old moss; silver moonlight pooling in the clearing of [[NPC:npc_forestmaster]].
- *Behaviors:* Spectral guardians testing the courage of travelers before opening the eastern pass toward [[Node:N_XAK_TSAROTH]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Hostile to all defilers and undead restlessness until the Forestmaster grants passage.

partyRapport.notes: The Forestmaster recognizes the true faith of Mishakal.

nodes.name: Xak Tsaroth (The Drowned Ruin)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Rotting cypress swamp hissing with black-dragon acid; wicker draconian idols; tilted marble colonnades plunging into a cavernous abyss around the rusted Great Lift chain.
- *Behaviors:* [[NPC:npc_bupu]] clutching her dead dried lizard and emerald; [[NPC:npc_khisanth]] coiled around the platinum [[Item:ITM-DISKS-MISHAKAL]].
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_xak_tsaroth]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Gully dwarf clans (Highbulp Phudge) scavenge beneath the tyranny of Khisanth and draconian taskmasters.

partyRapport.notes: Lair of the Black Dragon Khisanth (Onyx); Bupu is friendly to Raistlin.

nodes.name: Tower of High Sorcery at Wayreth
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Polished obsidian spires rising from a sentient, teleporting forest; the smell of ozone, old parchment, and burned flesh in the Chamber of the Test.
- *Behaviors:* [[NPC:npc_par_salian]] watching through silver mirrors as [[NPC:npc_fistandantilus]] whispers through [[Item:ITM-BLOODSTONE]] to [[NPC:npc_raistlin]].
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_wayreth_tower]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Absolute neutrality under the Three Moons (Solinari, Lunitari, Nuitari); non-initiates cannot locate the forest unless summoned.

partyRapport.notes: Par-Salian and the Conclave test initiates and observe the war across the moons.

nodes.name: Langtree & Baron Ivor's Mustering Grounds
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Muddy stockade churned by heavy warhorse hooves; smell of wet leather, cheap ale, and whetstones.
- *Behaviors:* [[NPC:npc_baron_ivor]] and [[NPC:npc_horkin]] drilling mercenary companies while young [[NPC:npc_raistlin]] and [[NPC:npc_caramon]] learn battlefield magic-and-steel tactics.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Hope's End (Vitrified Dragon-Glass Ruins)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Steep box-canyon walls fused into black volcanic dragon-glass by [[NPC:npc_immolatus]]'s fire breath; subterranean ice-vaults where the stolen Silver Dragon Eggs were held before being shipped to [[Node:N_SANCTION]].
- *Relationships:* Where [[NPC:npc_kitiara]] seduced [[NPC:npc_bakaris]] and forged her pact with the Dragonarmies.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_hopes_end_siege]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Gateway & Nightlund Border Road
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Charred border tollhouse; iron slave-cages creaking down the muddy ruts toward Pax Tharkas until [[NPC:npc_gilthanas]]'s elven archers strike at dawn.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Qualinost (Radiant City of the Sun Speaker)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Spires of rose-quartz and gilded glass linked by silver-filigree arches over aspen groves; the Hall of the Sky open to the stars.
- *Relationships:* [[NPC:npc_laurana]]'s fierce devotion to [[NPC:npc_tanis]] clashing with Porthios's dynastic protection.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Elven pride vs. urgent evacuation before Verminaard's Red Wing.

partyRapport.notes: Speaker Solostaran, Porthios, Gilthanas, and Laurana organize the Great Exodus.

nodes.name: The Sla-Mori (Secret Royal Crypt Tunnel)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Silent elven kings entombed in obsidian alcoves; Giant Slug slime trails; the deafening roar of molten iron chutes beneath the sixty-foot bronze Great Chain.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_sla_mori]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Pax Tharkas (Fortress of Peace / Red Wing Citadel)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Colossal twin curtain walls blocking the mountain pass; coal-smoke from the iron smelters; the nursery echoing with [[NPC:npc_flamestrike]]'s wheezing cough.
- *Relationships:* [[NPC:npc_verminaard]] preaching dark fatalism while [[NPC:npc_elistan]] receives [[Item:ITM-DISKS-MISHAKAL]] and [[NPC:npc_berem]] flees the subterranean cells.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_pax_tharkas]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: 250 hostage children held in the upper nursery under senile Flamestrike to keep 500 parents docile in the iron mines.

partyRapport.notes: Seat of Dragon Highlord Verminaard and his mace Nightbringer.

nodes.name: Skullcap & Derkin's Tomb
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* A mountain peak melted into a colossal green-glass skull where [[NPC:npc_fistandantilus]] detonated the Dwarfgate armies; spectral dwarven legions clashing in the mist.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_derkin_skullcap]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Thorbardin (Underground Kingdom of the Dwarves)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* The gigantic stalagmite-stalactite column of the Life Tree suspended over an underground sea; the rhythmic clang of a thousand forges.

minorities.name: Aghar Gully Dwarf (Sestun)
minorities.traits: Maintenance drudges around the Life Tree

demographics.social_friction_notes: Seven dwarven clans deadlocked without a High King until the Hammer of Kharas is restored.

partyRapport.notes: Returning the Hammer of Kharas opens sanctuary for the 800 Solace refugees.

nodes.name: Tarsis the Beautiful (Landlocked Dust-Port)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Sun-bleached marble arcades half-buried in red prairie dust; dry-rotted hulls of ancient swan-ships marooned forty miles from the sea; blue lightning and red dragonfire shattering the Red Dragon Inn.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_tarsis_square]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Icewall Castle & Glacial Spire
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Blue-green glacial ice carved into razor battlements; howling sub-zero gales; the howling of [[NPC:npc_feal_thas]]'s winter wolves.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_icewall_castle]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Ice Folk sail ice-boats across the glacier to topple Dark Elf Highlord Feal-Thas.

nodes.name: Silvanesti (The Nightmare Forest of King Lorac)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Weeping trees bleeding crimson sap; green chlorine fog exhaled by [[NPC:npc_cyan_bloodbane]] coiled around the dying throne of [[NPC:npc_lorac]]; reality twisting into personal nightmares.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_silvanesti_dream]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Southern Ergoth & Foghaven Valley (Tomb of Huma)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Shrouded mist-canyon concealing the colossal silver dragon statue of Huma's Tomb; [[NPC:npc_theros]] hammering white-hot dragonmetal with [[Item:ITM-SILVER-ARM]] and [[Item:ITM-HAMMER-KHARAS]] beside [[NPC:npc_silvara]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Sancrist Isle (Castle Gunthar & The Whitestone Glade)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* A towering white quartz boulder in awindswept meadow cleaved cleanly in two by [[NPC:npc_tasslehoff]] and [[NPC:npc_fizban]]; Solamnic banners snapping above [[NPC:npc_gunthar]]'s council hall.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Palanthas (The Ancient City & Great Library of Astinus)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Gleaming white marble avenues radiating like a wagon wheel around the cursed black-gated Tower of High Sorcery (`Shoikan Grove`); the silent scriptorium where [[NPC:npc_astinus]] writes with an unblinking quill.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: The High Clerist's Tower (West Gate Pass)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Grim grey-granite fortress engineered as a symmetrical dragon-trap; wind whistling through narrow kill-corridors; the sunlit western parapet where [[NPC:npc_sturm]] raises [[Item:ITM-BRIGHTBLADE]] against [[NPC:npc_kitiara]] and [[NPC:npc_skie]].
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_high_clerist_tower]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Kalaman (Northern Port & Allied War Headquarters)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Salt-sprayed stone seawalls overlooking the Turbidus Ocean; flying citadels casting eclipsing shadows over the harbor where [[NPC:npc_laurana]] is lured into [[NPC:npc_lord_soth]]'s trap.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Dargaard Keep (Citadel of the Death Knight)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Charred black-rose keep perched on a jagged crag in Nightlund; thirteen banshees wailing the curse of [[NPC:npc_lord_soth]] every midnight.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Flotsam (Lawless Blood Sea Corsair Port)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Ramshackle taverns smelling of bilge water, pickled herring, and draconian sweat; the docked caravel *Perechon* preparing to sail into the Blood Sea.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: The Blood Sea of Istar (Maelstrom & Sunken Temple)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Churning crimson whirlpool sucking warships down toward the cracked marble domes of drowned Istar; [[NPC:npc_raistlin]] turning his robes pitch-black under Nuitari's gaze.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Sanction (City of the Lords of Doom & Egg Vats)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Three active volcanoes (Lords of Doom) spewing rivers of orange magma through obsidian canals; the sulfurous vats of the Temple of Luerkhisis where Wyrllish and Dracart corrupt Good Dragon eggs into Draconians.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

nodes.name: Neraka (The Temple of Darkness & Imperial Encampment)
nodes.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* A twisted, shifting gothic cathedral of black obsidian wrenched from old Istar; 200,000 Dragonarmy soldiers camped across the volcanic valley; the cracked subterranean [[Item:ITM-FOUNDATION-STONE]] pulsing with the five-headed shadow of [[NPC:npc_takhisis]] (Q_SPR_03, CRUC-19..CRUC-23).
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_neraka_temple]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_SOLACE.name: Solace (The Valleys of the Trees)
N_SOLACE.displayName: Solace & Inn of the Last Home
N_SOLACE.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Colossal autumnal vallenwood trees cradling buildings in gold-and-scarlet boughs; suspended rope walkways creaking forty feet above leaf-mulched earth; cast-iron skillets sizzling with Otik's spiced potatoes.
- *Behaviors:* Townsfolk ascending rope ladders at dusk; hooded strangers checking satchels at the crossroads.
- *Relationships:* Deep tavern kinship around [[NPC:npc_otik]] and [[NPC:npc_tika]] strained by [[NPC:npc_hederick]]'s Seeker inquisition.
- *Attitudes:* Nostalgic warmth colliding with post-Cataclysm cynicism toward the old gods.
- *Values:* Hospitality of the hearth versus theocratic conformity.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_solace_inn]]. Connected to [[Node:N_HAVEN]], [[Node:N_CRYSTALMIR]], and [[Node:N_PAX_THARKAS]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: High Theocrat Hederick and Fewmaster Toede patrol the elevated boardwalks hunting the Blue Crystal Staff.

partyRapport.notes: Home sanctuary of the Companions at Otik Sandath's Inn of the Last Home.

N_HAVEN.name: Haven (Seat of the High Seekers)
N_HAVEN.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Whitewashed stone villas, cobble squares smelling of tallow candles, flash-powder sulfur from Belzor's shrine, and wet wool.
- *Behaviors:* Seeker magistrates weighing steel coins; apprentices reciting rote cantrips under [[NPC:npc_theobald]].
- *Relationships:* [[NPC:npc_antimodes]] secretly funding [[NPC:npc_raistlin]]'s schooling while [[NPC:npc_widow_judith]] stirs fanaticism.
- *Attitudes:* Complacent mercantile piety masking cowardly appeasement of [[Faction:fac_red_dragonarmy]].
- *Values:* Respectability, coin, and dogmatic orthodoxy.

minorities.name: Seeker Clerisy & Sellswords
minorities.traits: Tax collectors, charlatan priests, and Master Theobald's school

demographics.social_friction_notes: In 344-346 AC, Widow Judith's Belzor cult and Master Theobald's mediocre magic school dominate the stone squares.

partyRapport.notes: Bureaucratic Seeker capital; Antimodes maintains a suite at the Whitestone Inn.

N_CRYSTALMIR.name: Crystalmir Lake & Queer Idol Shore
N_CRYSTALMIR.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Cold mirror-dark alpine water reflecting autumn vallenwoods; the soot-blackened stone idol where [[NPC:npc_goldmoon]]'s [[Item:ITM-BLUE-STAFF]] blazes against [[NPC:npc_toede]]'s goblin ambush.
- *Behaviors:* Ferrymen poling flatboats through morning mist; Baaz draconians turning to crumbling stone when slain.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_DARKEN_WOOD.name: Darken Wood (Domain of the Forestmaster)
N_DARKEN_WOOD.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Ancient, lightless canopy smelling of crushed wintergreen, ozone, and centuries-old moss; silver moonlight pooling in the clearing of [[NPC:npc_forestmaster]].
- *Behaviors:* Spectral guardians testing the courage of travelers before opening the eastern pass toward [[Node:N_XAK_TSAROTH]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Hostile to all defilers and undead restlessness until the Forestmaster grants passage.

partyRapport.notes: The Forestmaster recognizes the true faith of Mishakal.

N_XAK_TSAROTH.name: Xak Tsaroth (The Drowned Ruin)
N_XAK_TSAROTH.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Rotting cypress swamp hissing with black-dragon acid; wicker draconian idols; tilted marble colonnades plunging into a cavernous abyss around the rusted Great Lift chain.
- *Behaviors:* [[NPC:npc_bupu]] clutching her dead dried lizard and emerald; [[NPC:npc_khisanth]] coiled around the platinum [[Item:ITM-DISKS-MISHAKAL]].
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_xak_tsaroth]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Gully dwarf clans (Highbulp Phudge) scavenge beneath the tyranny of Khisanth and draconian taskmasters.

partyRapport.notes: Lair of the Black Dragon Khisanth (Onyx); Bupu is friendly to Raistlin.

N_WAYRETH.name: Tower of High Sorcery at Wayreth
N_WAYRETH.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Polished obsidian spires rising from a sentient, teleporting forest; the smell of ozone, old parchment, and burned flesh in the Chamber of the Test.
- *Behaviors:* [[NPC:npc_par_salian]] watching through silver mirrors as [[NPC:npc_fistandantilus]] whispers through [[Item:ITM-BLOODSTONE]] to [[NPC:npc_raistlin]].
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_wayreth_tower]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Absolute neutrality under the Three Moons (Solinari, Lunitari, Nuitari); non-initiates cannot locate the forest unless summoned.

partyRapport.notes: Par-Salian and the Conclave test initiates and observe the war across the moons.

N_LANGTREE.name: Langtree & Baron Ivor's Mustering Grounds
N_LANGTREE.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Muddy stockade churned by heavy warhorse hooves; smell of wet leather, cheap ale, and whetstones.
- *Behaviors:* [[NPC:npc_baron_ivor]] and [[NPC:npc_horkin]] drilling mercenary companies while young [[NPC:npc_raistlin]] and [[NPC:npc_caramon]] learn battlefield magic-and-steel tactics.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_HOPES_END.name: Hope's End (Vitrified Dragon-Glass Ruins)
N_HOPES_END.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Steep box-canyon walls fused into black volcanic dragon-glass by [[NPC:npc_immolatus]]'s fire breath; subterranean ice-vaults where the stolen Silver Dragon Eggs were held before being shipped to [[Node:N_SANCTION]].
- *Relationships:* Where [[NPC:npc_kitiara]] seduced [[NPC:npc_bakaris]] and forged her pact with the Dragonarmies.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_hopes_end_siege]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_GATEWAY.name: Gateway & Nightlund Border Road
N_GATEWAY.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Charred border tollhouse; iron slave-cages creaking down the muddy ruts toward Pax Tharkas until [[NPC:npc_gilthanas]]'s elven archers strike at dawn.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_QUALINOST.name: Qualinost (Radiant City of the Sun Speaker)
N_QUALINOST.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Spires of rose-quartz and gilded glass linked by silver-filigree arches over aspen groves; the Hall of the Sky open to the stars.
- *Relationships:* [[NPC:npc_laurana]]'s fierce devotion to [[NPC:npc_tanis]] clashing with Porthios's dynastic protection.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Elven pride vs. urgent evacuation before Verminaard's Red Wing.

partyRapport.notes: Speaker Solostaran, Porthios, Gilthanas, and Laurana organize the Great Exodus.

N_SLA_MORI.name: The Sla-Mori (Secret Royal Crypt Tunnel)
N_SLA_MORI.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Silent elven kings entombed in obsidian alcoves; Giant Slug slime trails; the deafening roar of molten iron chutes beneath the sixty-foot bronze Great Chain.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_sla_mori]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_PAX_THARKAS.name: Pax Tharkas (Fortress of Peace / Red Wing Citadel)
N_PAX_THARKAS.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Colossal twin curtain walls blocking the mountain pass; coal-smoke from the iron smelters; the nursery echoing with [[NPC:npc_flamestrike]]'s wheezing cough.
- *Relationships:* [[NPC:npc_verminaard]] preaching dark fatalism while [[NPC:npc_elistan]] receives [[Item:ITM-DISKS-MISHAKAL]] and [[NPC:npc_berem]] flees the subterranean cells.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_pax_tharkas]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: 250 hostage children held in the upper nursery under senile Flamestrike to keep 500 parents docile in the iron mines.

partyRapport.notes: Seat of Dragon Highlord Verminaard and his mace Nightbringer.

N_DERKIN_TOMB.name: Skullcap & Derkin's Tomb
N_DERKIN_TOMB.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* A mountain peak melted into a colossal green-glass skull where [[NPC:npc_fistandantilus]] detonated the Dwarfgate armies; spectral dwarven legions clashing in the mist.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_derkin_skullcap]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_THORBARDIN.name: Thorbardin (Underground Kingdom of the Dwarves)
N_THORBARDIN.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* The gigantic stalagmite-stalactite column of the Life Tree suspended over an underground sea; the rhythmic clang of a thousand forges.

minorities.name: Aghar Gully Dwarf (Sestun)
minorities.traits: Maintenance drudges around the Life Tree

demographics.social_friction_notes: Seven dwarven clans deadlocked without a High King until the Hammer of Kharas is restored.

partyRapport.notes: Returning the Hammer of Kharas opens sanctuary for the 800 Solace refugees.

N_TARSIS.name: Tarsis the Beautiful (Landlocked Dust-Port)
N_TARSIS.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Sun-bleached marble arcades half-buried in red prairie dust; dry-rotted hulls of ancient swan-ships marooned forty miles from the sea; blue lightning and red dragonfire shattering the Red Dragon Inn.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_tarsis_square]].

N_ICEWALL.name: Icewall Castle & Glacial Spire
N_ICEWALL.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Blue-green glacial ice carved into razor battlements; howling sub-zero gales; the howling of [[NPC:npc_feal_thas]]'s winter wolves.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_icewall_castle]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Ice Folk sail ice-boats across the glacier to topple Dark Elf Highlord Feal-Thas.

N_SILVANESTI.name: Silvanesti (The Nightmare Forest of King Lorac)
N_SILVANESTI.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Weeping trees bleeding crimson sap; green chlorine fog exhaled by [[NPC:npc_cyan_bloodbane]] coiled around the dying throne of [[NPC:npc_lorac]]; reality twisting into personal nightmares.
Portal submap: [[Map:map_sub_silvanesti_dream]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_SOUTHERN_ERGOTH.name: Southern Ergoth & Foghaven Valley (Tomb of Huma)
N_SOUTHERN_ERGOTH.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Shrouded mist-canyon concealing the colossal silver dragon statue of Huma's Tomb; [[NPC:npc_theros]] hammering white-hot dragonmetal with [[Item:ITM-SILVER-ARM]] and [[Item:ITM-HAMMER-KHARAS]] beside [[NPC:npc_silvara]].

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_SANCRIST.name: Sancrist Isle (Castle Gunthar & The Whitestone Glade)
N_SANCRIST.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* A towering white quartz boulder in awindswept meadow cleaved cleanly in two by [[NPC:npc_tasslehoff]] and [[NPC:npc_fizban]]; Solamnic banners snapping above [[NPC:npc_gunthar]]'s council hall.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_PALANTHAS.name: Palanthas (The Ancient City & Great Library of Astinus)
N_PALANTHAS.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Gleaming white marble avenues radiating like a wagon wheel around the cursed black-gated Tower of High Sorcery (`Shoikan Grove`); the silent scriptorium where [[NPC:npc_astinus]] writes with an unblinking quill.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_HIGH_CLERIST_TOWER.name: The High Clerist's Tower (West Gate Pass)
N_HIGH_CLERIST_TOWER.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Grim grey-granite fortress engineered as a symmetrical dragon-trap; wind whistling through narrow kill-corridors; the sunlit western parapet where [[NPC:npc_sturm]] raises [[Item:ITM-BRIGHTBLADE]] against [[NPC:npc_kitiara]] and [[NPC:npc_skie]].

N_KALAMAN.name: Kalaman (Northern Port & Allied War Headquarters)

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_DARGAARD_KEEP.name: Dargaard Keep (Citadel of the Death Knight)
N_DARGAARD_KEEP.customNotes:
**5D Sensory Pentagon:**
- *Physical:* Charred black-rose keep perched on a jagged crag in Nightlund; thirteen banshees wailing the curse of [[NPC:npc_lord_soth]] every midnight.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_FLOTSAM.name: Flotsam (Lawless Blood Sea Corsair Port)

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

demographics.social_friction_notes: Post-Cataclysm suspicion of arcane magic and outsiders.

N_NERAKA.name: Neraka (The Temple of Darkness & Imperial Encampment)

npcs.name: Tanis Half-Elven (Tanthalas)
npcs.role: Reluctant Fellowship Leader & Half-Elven Ranger
npcs.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
npcs.motivation: Wound: Bastard child of rape rejected by Qualinost. Lie: He belongs to neither world. Want: Hold the fellowship together. Need: Choose authentic commitment (Laurana) over passionate chaos (Kitiara).

secretsKnown.secret: Still harbors agonizing guilt over his secret affair with Kitiara before the Five-Year separation.
Was viewed as a bastard outcast ("human in elven eyes, elf in human eyes") in Speaker Solostaran's court.

leverage.vulnerability: Divided heart between Laurana's light and Kitiara's dark magnetism.
leverage.bribe: Safe passage for the innocent refugees or Laurana's freedom.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "We keep moving together, or we die piecemeal in the trees." | Subtext: I am terrified that my next command will get another friend killed.
Spoken: "Raistlin may be cold, Sturm, but he has saved our lives twice today."

relationships.notes: True heart's anchor and Golden General.
Former lover, now Blue Dragon Highlord.
Lifelong mentor and father-figure in Solace.
Sworn brother-in-arms.

npcs.name: Sturm Brightblade
npcs.role: Squire of the Crown & Defender of the Measure
npcs.faction: The Knights of Solamnia (Crown, Sword & Rose)
npcs.motivation: Wound: Exile of his father's house after the peasant uprising at Castle Brightblade. Lie: Rigid adherence to the written Measure equals true honor. Want: Knighthood restoration. Need: Live and die by the spirit of Est Sularus oth Mithas.

secretsKnown.secret: Has never actually been formally knighted by the Solamnic Council despite wearing his father's armor and mustache.
Shared a strange, fateful moonlit journey north with Kitiara five years ago.

leverage.vulnerability: Cannot retreat when common soldiers or allies require a rearguard.
leverage.bribe: Vindication of his father's name before the Knighthood.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "Est Sularus oth Mithas—my honor is my life." | Subtext: Without this code, I am only an orphaned exile in borrowed plate.
Spoken: "I do not trust the mage's hourglass eyes, Tanis."

relationships.notes: Closest comrade despite philosophical friction.
Deep moral suspicion of Raistlin's dark ambition.
Accused of dishonor by Lord Derek Crownguard.
Bearer of Alhana's Starjewel.

npcs.name: Raistlin Majere
npcs.role: Mage of the Red (later Black) Robes
npcs.faction: The Orders of High Sorcery (Conclave of Wizards)
npcs.motivation: Wound: Frail body shattered in the Soulforge and lifelong resentment of Caramon's effortless strength. Lie: Power over life and death will silence his vulnerability. Want: Master Fistandantilus's arcane legacy. Need: Empathy for the weak (Bupu) and recognition of his brother's love.

secretsKnown.secret: Accepted the life-saving blood-pact of the ancient archmage Fistandantilus during the Test at Wayreth.
Murdered the illusory projection of his twin brother Caramon in the final chamber of the Test.

leverage.vulnerability: Crippling paroxysms of blood-coughing; genuine tenderness toward downtrodden outcasts like Bupu.
leverage.bribe: Ancient spellbooks of Fistandantilus and arcane autonomy.

dialogueHooks: Spoken (whispered rasp): "Look upon me with your healthy eyes, brother, and tell me what I owe their mercy." | Subtext: Every breath I draw is bought with pain you cannot fathom.
Spoken: "Shirak."

relationships.notes: Twin brother: fiercely resented yet indispensable shield.
Parasitic ancient soul sharing his mind.
Gentle compassion for the gully dwarf girl in Xak Tsaroth.
Half-sister who respects his ruthless ambition.

npcs.name: Caramon Majere
npcs.role: Veteran Heavy Warrior & Twin Guardian
npcs.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
npcs.motivation: Wound: Witnessing Raistlin's broken body at Wayreth and his own repressed horror at what he saw in the Test mirror. Lie: If he just hovers closer, he can save Raistlin's soul. Want: Protect Raistlin and win Tika's heart. Need: Stand as his own man even when Raistlin walks into the dark.

secretsKnown.secret: Represses the memory of watching Raistlin incinerate his illusion inside the Chamber of the Test.

leverage.vulnerability: Paralyzed whenever forced to choose between the Fellowship's survival and Raistlin's safety.
leverage.bribe: Herbal tea for Raistlin's cough or Otik's spiced potatoes.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "Here, Raist, lean on my arm—I've got the herbal brew simmering." | Subtext: Please don't slip away to a place my sword can't reach.
Spoken: "Tika? Since when did you learn to swing an iron skillet like that?"

relationships.notes: Devoted twin brother.
True love from the Inn of the Last Home.
Half-sister who taught him swordplay.

npcs.name: Goldmoon (Chieftain's Daughter of the Que-Shu)
npcs.role: First True Cleric of Mishakal
npcs.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
npcs.motivation: Wound: Stoned and exiled by her own Que-Shu tribe when Riverwind presented the Blue Crystal Staff. Lie: She is merely a mortal princess unworthy of divine burden. Want: Prove the truth of the Staff. Need: Become the vessel of Mishakal's faith.

secretsKnown.secret: Fears that the Blue Crystal Staff will demand Riverwind's life or her own in Xak Tsaroth.

leverage.vulnerability: Unwavering devotion to Riverwind and refusal to leave the wounded behind.
leverage.bribe: Unmoved by mundane coin; responds to alignment leverage.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "The ancient gods did not abandon Krynn—mortals turned their faces from them." | Subtext: If this faith fails in the dark, everything my tribe died for is ash.

relationships.notes: Beloved betrothed and sworn protector.
Passes the Disks of Mishakal to ordain Elistan.

npcs.role: Plainsman Ranger & Bearer of the Staff from Xak Tsaroth
npcs.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
npcs.motivation: Wound: Delirious fever-journey back from drowned Xak Tsaroth only to be stoned by his people. Want: Shield Goldmoon from both Seekers and Dragonarmies.

secretsKnown.secret: Survived the Black Dragon's swamp once before through Mishakal's intervention, though the fever erased the exact path until Darken Wood.

leverage.vulnerability: Bound by personal code and past scars.
leverage.bribe: Unmoved by mundane coin; responds to alignment leverage.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "Keep your hand off the Staff, priest, or lose the arm." | Subtext: I have carried this burden through black acid and death; no charlatan will touch her.

relationships.notes: Sworn love and life-partner.

npcs.motivation: Wound: Kender immunity to fear masking the crushing sorrow of watching friends die (Flint, Sturm). Want: Map every corner of Ansalon and protect his friends. Need: Learn that some fragile things—and mortal lives—cannot be put back together once broken.

Best friend of the befuddled old wizard in the battered hat.

quests.title: Memory Crucible I (346 AC Echo): The Soulforge of Wayreth
quests.name: Memory Crucible I (346 AC Echo): The Soulforge of Wayreth
quests.notes:
**Temporal Flashback (346 AC):** Touching the Bloodstone Pendant or resting inside the shifting grove of Wayreth projects the party backward in time into the Chamber of the Test on the night young Raistlin faced Liam's ambush, Fistandantilus's blood-pact, and the illusory murder of Caramon.
- **351 AC Campaign Payoff:** Mastering the memory echo unlocks Fistandantilus's True Command Word, granting decisive psychic armor against Cyan Bloodbane's nightmare in Silvanesti.

steps.title: Attune to the Bloodstone & Wayreth Mirror (Project to 346 AC)
steps.text: Enter the temporal memory projection of the Spiral of the Three Axioms in 346 AC Wayreth.

steps.title: Navigate Fistandantilus's Bargain & The Soul-Mirror
steps.text: Survive the crucible of the Test and claim Fistandantilus's True Command Word back in 351 AC.

quests.title: Memory Crucible II (347 AC Echo): Ashes of the Silver Clutch
quests.name: Memory Crucible II (347 AC Echo): Ashes of the Silver Clutch
quests.notes:
**Temporal Flashback (347 AC):** Investigating the vitrified black dragon-glass battlements of Hope's End or recovering the Scorched Silver Dragon Eggshell Shard projects the party into the final 48 hours of Mad Baron Ivor's Siege of Hope's End.
- **351 AC Campaign Payoff:** Witnessing Immolatus's seizure of D'Argent's silver clutch and Kitiara's bargain with Bakaris unlocks the Sanction Vault Seal, advancing the Awakening of the Metallic Dragon Flights by +2 ticks.

steps.title: Touch the Vitrified Dragon-Glass of Hope's End (Project to 347 AC)
steps.text: Project into the 347 AC mercenary mutiny alongside Captain Horkin, young Caramon, and Raistlin.

steps.title: Uncover the Subterranean Silver Clutch Vault
steps.text: Secure the Sanction Vault Seal before Immolatus incinerates the keep, advancing the Metallic Dragon Awakening in 351 AC.

quests.title: Autumn Twilight I: Flight from Solace & The Blue Crystal Staff
quests.name: Autumn Twilight I: Flight from Solace & The Blue Crystal Staff
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Escape Solace after High Theocrat Hederick's burned hand is miraculously healed at the Inn of the Last Home, cross Crystalmir Lake, and earn the Forestmaster's blessing in Darken Wood.
- **Key Stakes:** Goldmoon's Blue Crystal Staff reveals the first true divine magic on Krynn since the Cataclysm, drawing Fewmaster Toede's goblins and stone-turning Baaz draconian search-squads down upon Solace.

**Allegiance Approaches (Non-Canonical Cohort):**
- *Shadow Ally:* Hold the vallenwood rope-bridges and Crystalmir dock against Fewmaster Toede's goblins so Goldmoon and the Companions escape.
- *Freebooter / Conclave:* Smuggle rare spell-scrolls and steel out of Solace before the Seeker lockdown.
- *Dragonarmy Vanguard:* Lead the Baaz draconian search-squad into the Inn of the Last Home to corner the Blue Crystal Staff bearer.

steps.title: The Incident at the Inn of the Last Home
steps.text: Survive the confrontation with High Theocrat Hederick and Fewmaster Toede's guards on the elevated vallenwood walkways.

steps.title: Cross Crystalmir Lake & Enter Darken Wood
steps.text: Repel the Baaz draconian ambush on the northern shore and answer the Spectral Centaurs of the Forestmaster.

quests.title: Autumn Twilight II: The Drowned Spire of Xak Tsaroth
quests.name: Autumn Twilight II: The Drowned Spire of Xak Tsaroth
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Descend the Great Chain iron cauldron lift into the sunken ruins of Xak Tsaroth, win the aid of Bupu and the Aghar gully dwarves, confront the Black Dragon Khisanth, and haul the Platinum Disks of Mishakal out of the collapsing chasm.
- **Treasures of the Abyss:** Beyond the Disks of Mishakal in the lower treasury, the flooded library holds the Sunken Spellbook of Fistandantilus and the Glasses of True Seeing.

**Allegiance Approaches (Non-Canonical Cohort):**
- *Shadow Ally:* Hold the Great Chain winch against Kapak reinforcements while Goldmoon confronts Khisanth.
- *Freebooter / Conclave:* Race Raistlin to the Sunken Library to claim Fistandantilus's Grimoire or the Glasses of True Seeing.
- *Dragonarmy Vanguard:* Sabotage the Great Lift chains or ambush the exhausted Companions as they emerge from the chasm.

steps.title: Breach the Wicker Dragon Swamp & Temple of Mishakal
steps.text: Clear the Baaz wicker-dragon ambush on the marsh boardwalks and receive Mishakal's blessing at the surface statue.

steps.title: Bupu's Lift & The Sunken Library
steps.text: Navigate Highbulp Phudge's court with Bupu and recover Fistandantilus's sunken grimoire.

steps.title: Confront Khisanth for the Disks of Mishakal
steps.text: Defeat Khisanth with the Blue Crystal Staff and extract the 85-lb Platinum Disks before the cavern collapses.

quests.title: Autumn Twilight III: The Sla-Mori & Liberation of Pax Tharkas
quests.name: Autumn Twilight III: The Sla-Mori & Liberation of Pax Tharkas
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Infiltrate Pax Tharkas through the secret elven Sla-Mori crypts and the sixty-foot bronze Great Chain, free the 250 hostage children from the senile red dragon Flamestrike's nursery, ordain Elistan with the Disks of Mishakal, and bring down Highlord Verminaard.
- **Key Turning Points:** Claiming Kith-Kanan's ancient greatsword Wyrmslayer in the Sla-Mori crypts and freeing the mute prisoner Berem the Everman from the lower slave pens.

**Allegiance Approaches (Non-Canonical Cohort):**
- *Shadow Ally:* Hold the Sla-Mori tunnel rear-guard and sabotage the Great Gate winch while Tanis and Laurana free the nursery.
- *Freebooter / Conclave:* Spring Berem the Everman from the subterranean cells to learn the secret of his Green Gemstone first.
- *Dragonarmy Vanguard:* Reinforce Highlord Verminaard and Pyros in the audience sanctum or redirect the Red Wing against the Qualinesti fleet.

steps.title: Traverse the Sla-Mori & Claim Wyrmslayer
steps.text: Unlock the secret elven crypts, claim Wyrmslayer from Kith-Kanan's tomb, and ascend the molten bronze Great Chain.

steps.title: Liberate the Nursery & Ordain Elistan
steps.text: Soothe Flamestrike in the upper nursery and deliver the Disks of Mishakal to Elistan in the iron mine slave pens.

steps.title: Fall of Highlord Verminaard
steps.text: Slay Verminaard in the audience hall as Flamestrike attacks Pyros, leading 800 freed refugees into the Kharolis mountains.

quests.title: Winter Night I: Skullcap, Eben's Treason & The Hammer of Kharas
quests.name: Winter Night I: Skullcap, Eben's Treason & The Hammer of Kharas
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Brave the vitrified green-glass ruins of Skullcap, recover the ancient Helm of Grallen from Derkin's Tomb, foil Eben Shatterstone's betrayal, and win winter sanctuary and the Hammer of Kharas inside subterranean Thorbardin.

**Allegiance Approaches (Non-Canonical Cohort):**
- *Shadow Ally:* Track and intercept Eben Shatterstone's Red Wing signal-team in the Kharolis snow passes.
- *Freebooter / Conclave:* Negotiate directly with the Hylar and Theiwar thanes around the Life Tree for dwarven steel and passage.
- *Dragonarmy Vanguard:* Coordinate with Eben Shatterstone to spring the Red Dragonarmy pincer on the refugee camp.

steps.title: Delve Skullcap & Foil Eben's Betrayal
steps.text: Recover the Helm of Grallen from the sunken tomb chamber and confront Eben Shatterstone at the shadow-guardian causeway.

steps.title: Restore the Hammer of Kharas in Thorbardin
steps.text: Present the Helm of Grallen to the Council of Thanes and secure the Hammer of Kharas and refugee sanctuary.

quests.title: Winter Night II: The Burning of Landlocked Tarsis
quests.name: Winter Night II: The Burning of Landlocked Tarsis
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Discover the landlocked hulls of Tarsis on the Plains of Dust, uncover the ancient Dragon Orb clue in the basement library, and survive Kitiara and Bakaris's Blue Wing blitz on the Red Dragon Inn.
- **Pivotal Crossroads:** During the burning of Tarsis, decide whether the Fellowship splits into two theaters (Silvanesti and Icewall) as in the novels, or rallies around Alhana Starbreeze's griffons to hold together as a unified company.

**Allegiance Approaches (Non-Canonical Cohort):**
- *Shadow Ally:* Hold the Red Dragon Inn courtyard and secure Alhana's griffons so the entire Fellowship escapes intact.
- *Freebooter / Conclave:* Extract the ancient navigation charts to Icewall and Ergoth from the burning magistrate's hall.
- *Dragonarmy Vanguard:* Lead the Blue Wing street sweep alongside Lord Bakaris to split or capture the Heroes at the Red Dragon Inn.

steps.title: Uncover the Cracked Dragon Orb Clue in Tarsis
steps.text: Investigate the dry-rotted harbor and the basement library before the city watch locks the gates.

steps.title: The Red Dragon Inn Blitz (Split vs. Unified Stand)
steps.text: Survive the Blue and Red Dragon strafing run and choose whether the Fellowship splits into two tracks or stands unified.

quests.title: Winter Night III-A: Lorac's Nightmare in Silvanesti
quests.name: Winter Night III-A: Lorac's Nightmare in Silvanesti
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Traverse the bleeding hallucination-forest of Silvanesti, overcome your party's phantom death-visions, banish the green dragon Cyan Bloodbane from the Tower of the Stars, and claim the Silvanesti Dragon Orb.
- **Memory Synergy:** If the party completed the Soulforge of Wayreth (or its 346 AC Memory Crucible), Fistandantilus's True Command Word shields the company from the nightmare's psychic drain.

steps.title: Walk the Bleeding Grove of Hallucinations
steps.text: Pierce the personal nightmare illusions conjured by the Silvanesti Dragon Orb.

steps.title: Banish Cyan Bloodbane & Claim the Silvanesti Orb
steps.text: Confront Cyan Bloodbane at Speaker Lorac's crystal throne and master the Silvanesti Dragon Orb.

quests.title: Winter Night III-B: Icewall, Foghaven & Forging the Dragonlances
quests.name: Winter Night III-B: Icewall, Foghaven & Forging the Dragonlances
quests.notes: **Objective:** Storm Icewall Castle to slay Highlord Feal-Thas and recover the Icewall Dragon Orb, journey with Silvara and Theros Ironfeld to the Tomb of Huma on Southern Ergoth to forge the True Dragonlances, and present them before the Whitestone Council on Sancrist Isle.

steps.title: Storm Icewall Castle & Claim the Dragon Orb
steps.text: Defeat Highlord Feal-Thas and the white wyrm Sleet in the throne hall and secure the intact Icewall Dragon Orb.

steps.title: Forge the True Dragonlances in Foghaven Valley
steps.text: Escort Silvara and Theros Ironfeld to the Tomb of Huma on Southern Ergoth to unite the Silver Arm and Hammer of Kharas.

steps.title: Unite the Whitestone Council on Sancrist
steps.text: Present the forged Dragonlances before Lord Gunthar's council and dispatch reinforcements to the High Clerist's Tower.

quests.title: Winter Night IV: Siege of the High Clerist's Tower
quests.name: Winter Night IV: Siege of the High Clerist's Tower
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Uncover the architectural secret of the High Clerist's Tower as a giant Dragon-Trap, arm the narrow stone kill-corridors with Dragonlances, and master the Dragon Orb in the lower vault as Kitiara's Blue Wing storms the pass.
- **The Sunlit Parapet Crucible:** Follow the poignant novel canon where Sturm Brightblade's sacrifice shatters Solamnic factionalism and crowns Laurana as the Golden General—or trigger the divergent branch by reinforcing the West Gate and parrying Kitiara's dive with Brightblade so Sturm survives as Lord of the Rose.

**Allegiance Approaches (Non-Canonical Cohort):**
- *Shadow Ally:* Brace the Dragonlance kill-corridors or stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Sturm on the western parapet so he survives Kitiara's dive.
- *Freebooter / Conclave:* Guard Tasslehoff and Laurana in the Lower Orb Vault against draconian sappers.
- *Dragonarmy Vanguard:* Fly with Highlord Kitiara and Bakaris to shatter the Dragon Orb and break the Palanthas pass.

steps.title: Survive Derek's Folly & Arm the Kill-Corridors
steps.text: Decipher the tower's dragon-trap geometry with Tasslehoff and arm the narrow stone funnels with Dragonlances.

steps.title: The Sunlit Parapet & The Dragon Orb
steps.text: Hold the western parapet with Sturm against Kitiara and Skie while Laurana activates the Dragon Orb to lure the Blue Dragons into the lance traps.

quests.title: Spring Dawning I: The Blood Sea Maelstrom & Library of Palanthas
quests.name: Spring Dawning I: The Blood Sea Maelstrom & Library of Palanthas
quests.notes: **Objective:** Sail from Flotsam aboard the Perechon, survive Kitiara's aerial boarding strike over the crimson whirlpool of the Blood Sea of Istar, uncover the ancient origin of Berem's Green Gemstone in the sunken ruins, and witness Raistlin don the Black Robes and claim the Tower of Palanthas before the chronicler Astinus.

steps.title: Sail from Flotsam into the Blood Sea Maelstrom
steps.text: Evade Kitiara's boarding strike aboard the Perechon as Raistlin dons the Black Robes and teleports to Palanthas.

steps.title: Learn Berem's Secret in Sunken Istar & Palanthas
steps.text: Uncover how Berem's Green Gemstone was pried from the Foundation Stone and witness Astinus greet Raistlin in Palanthas.

quests.title: Spring Dawning II: Sanction's Egg Vats & Awakening of the Good Dragons
quests.name: Spring Dawning II: Sanction's Egg Vats & Awakening of the Good Dragons
quests.notes: **Objective:** Infiltrate Sanction's volcanic Temple of Luerkhisis with Silvara, Gilthanas, and Fizban to expose the draconian corruption of the Good Dragon eggs, shattering the Metallic Dragons' coerced neutrality oath while Kitiara and Death Knight Lord Soth abduct Laurana from Kalaman.

steps.title: Breach the Volcanic Temple of Luerkhisis in Sanction
steps.text: Guide Silvara, Gilthanas, and Fizban through the Mount Terk lava ducts to expose the Draconian egg corruption vats.

steps.title: Unleash the Metallic Dragon Flights & March on Neraka
steps.text: Shatter the Good Dragons' neutrality oath and ride north as Kitiara summons Tanis to Neraka for the captive Laurana.

quests.title: Spring Dawning III: The Temple of Darkness at Neraka
quests.name: Spring Dawning III: The Temple of Darkness at Neraka
quests.notes:
**Objective:** Infiltrate the warped Temple of Darkness at Neraka on the Night of the Eye as all five Dragonarmies assemble before Emperor Ariakas.
- **Five Playable Climax Outcomes:**
 1. *Canonical Triumph:* Raistlin drops Ariakas's arcane ward, Tanis slays Ariakas and rejects the Crown of Power, Berem seals the Foundation Stone in the lower vault, Laurana denies Lord Soth, and the Temple of Darkness collapses.
 2. *The Dragon Emperor:* Claim the Crown of Power to rule Ansalon beside Highlord Kitiara.
 3. *The Dragon Empress:* Aid Kitiara and Lord Soth in overthrowing Ariakas to unite all five Dragonarmies under the Blue Wing.
 4. *The Black Godhead:* Aid Black-Robe Raistlin in stepping through the unsealed Foundation Gate to challenge Takhisis in the Abyss.
 5. *Age of Darkness:* Deliver Berem the Everman to High Cleric Dracart's altar so Takhisis manifests in the skies of Krynn.

steps.title: Infiltrate the Council Amphitheater & Slay Emperor Ariakas
steps.text: Coordinate with Black-Robe Raistlin or Highlord Kitiara to drop Ariakas's force-shield and seize the Crown of Power.

steps.title: Escort Berem to the Foundation Stone Vault
steps.text: Battle Gakhan and High Cleric Dracart in the lower vaults so Berem reunites the Green Gemstone with Jasla's spirit—or claim the portal.

steps.title: Escape the Collapsing Temple of Darkness
steps.text: Break Laurana free of Lord Soth's claim, resolve the Crown of Power, and witness Raistlin ascend astride Cyan Bloodbane as Master of Past and Present.

items.name: The Blue Crystal Staff of Mishakal
items.specs: 20-charge divine healing & radiant smiting staff; deflects strikes from evil creatures; blazes with azure fire against Khisanth.
items.notes: Recovered by Riverwind from the sunken temple of Xak Tsaroth and borne by Goldmoon.

items.name: The Platinum Disks of Mishakal
items.specs: 85-lb spiral-bound concave platinum plates inscribed with the true doctrines of the Gods of Good.
items.notes: Guarded by Khisanth in Xak Tsaroth. Reading them ordains Elistan as the first True Cleric of Paladine in 351 AC.

items.name: The Staff of Magius
items.specs: Blackwood staff topped with a golden dragon claw clutching a crystal orb; +2 AC, continual light ("Shirak"/"Dulak"), and spell amplification.
items.notes: Awarded to Raistlin by Par-Salian after the Test of High Sorcery at Wayreth.

items.name: The Bloodstone Pendant of Fistandantilus
items.specs: Dark green heliotrope flecked with arterial red; psychic soul-conduit linking Raistlin to Fistandantilus; grants temporal memory resonance.
items.notes: Touched in The Soulforge of Wayreth to trigger *The Soulforge Echo (346 AC)*; central to CRUC-03 and CRUC-16.

items.name: Sunken Spellbook of Fistandantilus
items.specs: Silver-runed dragonhide tome readable only through hourglass eyes or Bloodstone attunement.
items.notes: Hidden in the sunken library of Xak Tsaroth and revealed to Raistlin by Bupu.

items.name: Brightblade (Ancestral Two-Handed Sword)
items.specs: +3 Solamnic broadsword engraved with the rose, crown, and kingfisher; unbreakable so long as its wielder's honor holds.
items.notes: Borne by Sturm Brightblade from Solace to the sunlit parapet of the High Clerist's Tower.

items.name: Wyrmslayer (Sword of Kith-Kanan)
items.specs: Ancient elven greatsword (+3 vs. Dragons) humming with a warning vibration whenever draconic malice is near.
items.notes: Recovered by Tanis from the sarcophagus of Kith-Kanan in the Sla-Mori.

items.name: Tasslehoff's Hoopak & Pouches of Borrowing
items.specs: Iron-shod ash sling-staff emitting an eerie bullroarer whir when spun; paired with lockpicks and borrowed curios.
items.notes: Carried by Tasslehoff Burrfoot across Ansalon.

items.name: Glasses of True Seeing
items.specs: Rose-tinted wire spectacles enabling the wearer to read any language or cipher.
items.notes: Found by Tasslehoff in Xak Tsaroth.

items.name: Scorched Silver Dragon Eggshell Shard
items.specs: Iridescent metallic shell fragment bearing the residue of Sanction's dark transmutation.
items.notes: Resonant trigger for Ashes of the Silver Clutch (*Ashes of the Silver Clutch — 347 AC*) and forensic proof for Silvara and the Good Dragons.

items.name: Nightbringer (Heavy Mace of Verminaard)
items.specs: +3 black-iron flanged mace of Takhisis that blinds struck foes in utter darkness.
items.notes: Wielded by Dragon Highlord Verminaard in the audience hall of Pax Tharkas.

items.name: The Helm of Grallen
items.specs: Silver-and-gemstone dwarven war-helm of Prince Grallen; proves noble intent to the Thorbardin thanes.
items.notes: Recovered from the spectral ruins of Skullcap / Derkin's Tomb.

items.name: The Hammer of Kharas
items.specs: Sacred warhammer of the dwarven hero Kharas; the only forging tool capable of shaping pure dragonmetal into True Dragonlances.
items.notes: Restored in Thorbardin and carried by Theros Ironfeld to Foghaven Valley.

items.name: The Silver Arm of Ergoth
items.specs: Articulated prosthetic arm of pure blessed silver; bonds to a master smith to channel Paladine's forging fire.
items.notes: Grafted onto Theros Ironfeld after losing his arm in Solace.

items.name: The Dragon Orb of Icewall
items.specs: Size-changing crystal sphere housing an ancient dragon intelligence; compels evil dragons to dive into traps if the wielder wins a battle of wills.
items.notes: Recovered from Highlord Feal-Thas at Icewall, shattered or mastered at the Whitestone Council / High Clerist's Tower.

items.name: The Dragon Orb of Silvanesti
items.specs: Green-misted crystal orb used by Cyan Bloodbane to trap King Lorac in a living nightmare.
items.notes: Mastered by Raistlin in Silvanesti and carried into the Blood Sea and Palanthas.

items.name: The Starjewel of Alhana Starbreeze
items.specs: Radiant diamond pendant linking two souls across any distance on Krynn.
items.notes: Gifted by Princess Alhana Starbreeze to Sturm Brightblade upon parting in Silvanesti.

items.name: True Footman's Dragonlance of Huma
items.specs: 8-foot gleaming silver dragonmetal pike (+4 vs. Dragons, deals wielder's full HP on a mounted/braced strike).
items.notes: Forged in Foghaven Valley by Theros Ironfeld and deployed in the kill-corridors of the High Clerist's Tower.

items.name: True Mounted Dragonlance of Huma
items.specs: 16-foot balanced silver dragonlance with dragon-wing vamplate designed for aerial dragonback combat.
items.notes: Wielded by the Knights of Solamnia and Metallic Dragon riders during the Sanction and Neraka campaigns.

items.name: The Crown of Power (Imperial Diadem of Takhisis)
items.specs: Five-clawed golden dragon crown set with a blood-red ruby; confers supreme command over all five Dragonarmies.
items.notes: Worn by Emperor Ariakas in Neraka; contested by Tanis, Kitiara, and the Highlords.

items.name: The Cracked Foundation Stone of Istar / Neraka
items.specs: Ancient jeweled temple pillar missing a single green gemstone; serves as Takhisis's planar gate into Krynn while incomplete.
items.notes: Sealed only when Berem the Everman reunites the green gemstone in his chest with his sister Jasla's spirit.

items.name: The Living Green Gemstone (Chest of the Everman)
items.specs: Priceless emerald fused into the flesh over Berem's heart; grants immortality and resurrection until returned to the Foundation Stone.
items.notes: Pried from the Foundation Stone 300 years ago, causing Jasla's death and locking Takhisis's portal.

trackers.name: The Heroes of the Lance Odyssey Clock (Autonomous Mode B)
trackers.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
trackers.notes: Tracks the autonomous movement of the canonical Heroes of the Lance across Ansalon in Versions 2 & 3. Advancing each tick triggers Clock Threshold Consequences that physically relocate Tanis, Raistlin, Caramon, Sturm, Goldmoon, Riverwind, Tas, and Flint (and their carried artifacts!) across the pointcrawl nodes. Intercept them at any node to aid, rival, or ambush them!

consequences.description: Tick 1 (Reunion at Solace): The Companions reunite at the Inn of the Last Home as Goldmoon reveals the Blue Crystal Staff.
Tick 2 (Descent into Xak Tsaroth): The Companions cross Darken Wood into drowned Xak Tsaroth to confront Khisanth for the Disks of Mishakal.
Tick 3 (Capture & Flight to Qualinost): Captured in burned Solace, the Companions are rescued at Gateway by Gilthanas and enter Qualinost.
Tick 4 (Infiltration of Pax Tharkas): The Companions creep through the Sla-Mori into Verminaard's fortress of Pax Tharkas.
Tick 5 (Skullcap & Gates of Thorbardin): Leading 800 freed refugees, the Companions delve Derkin's Tomb and recover the Hammer of Kharas in Thorbardin.
Tick 6 (Ambush in Landlocked Tarsis): Kitiara's Blue Wing strafes the Red Dragon Inn in Tarsis, threatening to split the Fellowship.
Tick 7 (The Two Theaters — Silvanesti & Icewall): Tanis and Raistlin enter Lorac's Nightmare in Silvanesti while Sturm, Laurana, Flint, and Tas assault Feal-Thas at Icewall.
Tick 8 (Southern Ergoth & The Whitestone Council): Silvara guides the southern company to Foghaven Valley to forge the Dragonlances before sailing to Sancrist.
Tick 9 (Siege of the High Clerist's Tower): Sturm, Laurana, Flint, and Tas hold the High Clerist's Tower against Kitiara's Blue Wing.
Tick 10 (Blood Sea Maelstrom & Black Robes): Tanis's company is sucked into the Blood Sea of Istar; Raistlin dons the Black Robes and teleports to Astinus in Palanthas.
Tick 11 (Kalaman & The Egg Vaults of Sanction): Laurana leads the northern liberation at Kalaman while Silvara and Gilthanas infiltrate Sanction's Temple of Luerkhisis.
Tick 12 (Convergence at the Temple of Neraka): All surviving Companions, Highlords, Raistlin, and Berem the Everman converge on Neraka for the Night of the Eye.

trackers.name: The Soulforge Crucible & Fistandantilus Pact
trackers.faction: The Orders of High Sorcery (Conclave of Wizards)
trackers.notes: Tracks the psychic and physical toll of the Test of High Sorcery at Wayreth. At 4/6 ticks, Fistandantilus offers the Bloodstone bargain to save Raistlin from dragonfire. At 6/6 ticks, the Soul-Mirror illusion of Caramon manifests in the final chamber.

consequences.description: Fistandantilus whispers from the Bloodstone inside the Chamber of the Test, offering arcane survival in exchange for a future life-tithe.
The Soul-Mirror manifests the illusion of Caramon effortlessly wielding magic.

trackers.name: Siege of Hope's End & Immolatus's Descent (347 AC)
trackers.faction: The Red Dragonarmy & Imperial Command of Neraka
trackers.notes: Tracks Baron Ivor's mercenary bombardment and the Red Dragon Immolatus's secret seizure of the Silver Dragon Clutch. At 6/6 ticks, Immolatus vitrifies the valley walls into black dragon-glass.

consequences.description: The Red Dragon Immolatus descends in fire, fusing the walls of Hope's End into black dragon-glass while the Silver Clutch is spirited toward Sanction.

trackers.name: Verminaard's Abanasinian Crusade & Qualinost Assault
trackers.faction: The Red Dragonarmy & Imperial Command of Neraka
trackers.notes: Advances when road checkpoints are tripped or the party delays in Darken Wood and Xak Tsaroth. At 4/8 ticks, Solace is burned and the townsfolk are marched in iron cages toward Pax Tharkas. At 8/8 ticks, Verminaard's Red Wing launches a full aerial blitz against the Qualinesti Exodus before the elven fleet can sail.

consequences.description: Solace is occupied by Verminaard's Red Wing; the townsfolk are marched in iron cages toward Pax Tharkas.
Verminaard launches the full Red Wing aerial blitz against the Qualinesti Exodus.

trackers.name: Blue Wing Siege of the High Clerist's Tower
trackers.faction: The Blue Dragonarmy (Wing of the Blue Lady)
trackers.notes: Tracks Kitiara and Bakaris's assault on the West Gate Pass of Palanthas. At 4/8 ticks, Derek Crownguard's sally is routed outside the West Gate. At 6/8 ticks, Kitiara and Skie dive toward Sturm Brightblade on the sunlit parapet. At 8/8 ticks, if the Dragon Orb in the lower vault is not mastered, the High Clerist's Tower falls.

consequences.description: Highlord Kitiara and the blue dragon Skie dive upon Sturm Brightblade on the western parapet while Laurana contests the Dragon Orb below.

trackers.name: Awakening of the Metallic Dragon Flights
trackers.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
trackers.notes: Tracks the gathering of forensic proof—from the Scorched Silver Dragon Eggshell Shard at Hope's End to the infiltration of the volcanic Temple of Luerkhisis in Sanction—proving that Takhisis broke her hostage oath by mutating Good Dragon eggs into Draconians. At 6/6 ticks, the Gold, Silver, Bronze, Brass, and Copper Dragons enter the war.

consequences.description: The Metallic Dragons shatter their coerced neutrality oath and descend upon the skies of Ansalon carrying Solamnic Dragonlance Riders.

trackers.name: Night of the Eye: Takhisis's Planar Manifestation
trackers.faction: The Red Dragonarmy & Imperial Command of Neraka
trackers.notes: Master apocalyptic countdown in the Temple of Darkness at Neraka. Advances as the three moons align on the Night of the Eye. Stopped permanently only when Berem the Everman seals the Foundation Stone or Raistlin turns against the Dark Queen.

consequences.description: The Foundation Stone ruptures—Takhisis manifests in the mortal sky unless Berem's Green Gemstone seals the threshold.

factions.name: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
factions.description: The disparate fellowship bound by the Five-Year Oath at the Inn of the Last Home who recover the true gods of Good, liberate the Pax Tharkas slaves, and forge the Whitestone coalition.
factions.notes: Parley Matrix: Moves on loyalty, personal sacrifice, and protection of the innocent. Taboo: Abandoning friends or trading lives for strategic expediency.

factions.name: The Knights of Solamnia (Crown, Sword & Rose)
factions.description: Ancient knighthood bound by Est Sularus oth Mithas ("My Honor is My Life") and the thirty-volume Measure, fractured between Lord Gunthar Uth Wistan's reformers and Derek Crownguard's rigid legalists.
factions.notes: Whitestone Parley Matrix: Gunthar's bloc votes for unified command if presented with the forged Dragonlances; Derek's bloc demands strict adherence to the Measure and distrusts elves and Red/Black Robe wizards.

factions.name: The Orders of High Sorcery (Conclave of Wizards)
factions.description: The sovereign brotherhood of White (Solinari), Red (Lunitari), and Black (Nuitari) Robe mages holding the Law of Magic above all mundane thrones and enforcing the lethal Test of High Sorcery at Wayreth.
factions.notes: Conclave Parley Matrix: Unmoved by political borders; immediately unites against un-tested renegades or any threat to the balance of the Three Moons.

factions.name: The Red Dragonarmy & Imperial Command of Neraka
factions.description: The largest of the five Dragonarmies, forged around the volcanic egg-vats of Sanction and commanded by Emperor Ariakas in Neraka and Highlord Verminaard in Abanasinia.
factions.notes: Highlord Council Parley Matrix: Ruled by Takhisis's Darwinian law—treason is expected if it succeeds, fatal if it fails. Ariakas guards the Crown of Power behind an arcane shield.

factions.name: The Blue Dragonarmy (Wing of the Blue Lady)
factions.description: Highlord Kitiara Uth Matar's disciplined, fiercely loyal northern wing, backed by the ancient blue dragon Skie, Flying Citadels, and a dark compact with Death Knight Lord Soth.
factions.notes: Blue Wing Parley Matrix: Kitiara respects audacity, martial competence, and personal leverage over Ariakas; she harbors conflicted possessive feelings toward Tanis and her twin brothers.

factions.name: The White Dragonarmy (Glacial Wing)
factions.description: Smallest of the five wings, garrisoning Icewall Castle under the Silvanesti dark-elf necromancer Feal-Thas, his winter wolf packs, Walrus-men (Than-Kar), and the white wyrm Sleet.
factions.notes: Guards the Icewall Dragon Orb in the southern glacial spire.

factions.name: The Green & Black Dragonarmies (Swamp & Dream Wings)
factions.description: Anchored by the ancient green dragon Cyan Bloodbane (corrupting King Lorac's dream through the Silvanesti Orb) and the black dragon Khisanth in the sunken ruins of Xak Tsaroth.
factions.notes: Operates via poison gas, acid swamps, and hallucinatory psychological terror.

factions.name: The Elven Kingdoms in Exile (Qualinesti & Silvanesti)
factions.description: The estranged eastern (Silvanesti) and western (Qualinesti) elven houses, forced out of their ancient homelands onto Southern Ergoth and united through the courage of Laurana and Alhana Starbreeze.
factions.notes: Sun Council & Exile Parley Matrix: Distrusts humans and dwarves; won over only when Laurana recovers the Dragon Orb and Silvara reveals the Tomb of Huma.

factions.name: The Kingdom of Thorbardin (Council of Thanes)
factions.description: The sealed mountain kingdom of Hylar, Daewar, Theiwar, Klar, and Neidar dwarves beneath the Kharolis peaks, scarred by the memory of Fistandantilus's Dwarfgate War.
factions.notes: Council of Thanes Parley Matrix: Refuses to open the Northgate to surface refugees unless the Hammer of Kharas or Helm of Grallen is presented.

factions.name: The High Seekers of Haven & Cult of Belzor
factions.description: The hollow post-Cataclysm priesthood that purports to "seek" new gods while taxing Abanasinia and collaborating with Verminaard's Red Dragonarmy to preserve their own wealth.
factions.notes: Collapses when Hederick witnesses true divine miracles or when Verminaard discards them at Pax Tharkas.

# MODULE MOD_T1_HIGHLORD_COUNCIL_CONCLAVE: THE IMPERIAL HIGHLORD CONCLAVE OF NERAKA

## Granular Disposition Baseline ([1, 1, 1])

### 1. Executive Summary & Egri Premise
Darwinian military summit of the five Dragonarmies at Neraka where Emperor Ariakas rules via the Crown of Power while Highlord Kitiara plots her coup (`CRUC-19`, `CRUC-23`).

- **Pipeline Tier:** Tier 1
- **Provides:** `crown_of_power_dominion`
- **Requires:** `draconian_army_reinforcements`
- **Standalone Fallback:** Each Dragonarmy Wing operates as an autonomous regional warlord state if Neraka's central command collapses.

### 2. 5D Sensory Pentagon
- **Physical Environment:** Five colored dragon banners whipping in volcanic ash above 200,000 armored troops; the ruby glow of the Crown of Power.
- **Behaviors:** Highlords exchanging poisoned compliments while Black Robe mages maintain Ariakas's force-shield.
- **Relationships:** Kitiara and Lord Soth conspiring against Ariakas while Raistlin plays both sides.
- **Attitudes:** Ruthless ambition masked as devotion to Takhisis.
- **Values:** Strength, betrayal rewarded by victory, and imperial dominion.

### 3. Dramatic Opposition Web (4-Corner Matrix)

npcs.name: Tanis Half-Elven (Tanthalas)
npcs.role: Reluctant Fellowship Leader & Half-Elven Ranger
npcs.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
npcs.motivation: Wound: Bastard child of rape rejected by Qualinost. Lie: He belongs to neither world. Want: Hold the fellowship together. Need: Choose authentic commitment (Laurana) over passionate chaos (Kitiara).

secretsKnown.secret: Still harbors agonizing guilt over his secret affair with Kitiara before the Five-Year separation.
Was viewed as a bastard outcast ("human in elven eyes, elf in human eyes") in Speaker Solostaran's court.

leverage.vulnerability: Divided heart between Laurana's light and Kitiara's dark magnetism.
leverage.bribe: Safe passage for the innocent refugees or Laurana's freedom.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "We keep moving together, or we die piecemeal in the trees." | Subtext: I am terrified that my next command will get another friend killed.
Spoken: "Raistlin may be cold, Sturm, but he has saved our lives twice today."

relationships.notes: True heart's anchor and Golden General.
Former lover, now Blue Dragon Highlord.
Lifelong mentor and father-figure in Solace.
Sworn brother-in-arms.

npcs.name: Sturm Brightblade
npcs.role: Squire of the Crown & Defender of the Measure
npcs.faction: The Knights of Solamnia (Crown, Sword & Rose)
npcs.motivation: Wound: Exile of his father's house after the peasant uprising at Castle Brightblade. Lie: Rigid adherence to the written Measure equals true honor. Want: Knighthood restoration. Need: Live and die by the spirit of Est Sularus oth Mithas.

secretsKnown.secret: Has never actually been formally knighted by the Solamnic Council despite wearing his father's armor and mustache.
Shared a strange, fateful moonlit journey north with Kitiara five years ago.

leverage.vulnerability: Cannot retreat when common soldiers or allies require a rearguard.
leverage.bribe: Vindication of his father's name before the Knighthood.

dialogueHooks: Spoken: "Est Sularus oth Mithas—my honor is my life." | Subtext: Without this code, I am only an orphaned exile in borrowed plate.
Spoken: "I do not trust the mage's hourglass eyes, Tanis."

relationships.notes: Closest comrade despite philosophical friction.
Deep moral suspicion of Raistlin's dark ambition.
Accused of dishonor by Lord Derek Crownguard.
Bearer of Alhana's Starjewel.

npcs.name: Raistlin Majere
npcs.role: Mage of the Red (later Black) Robes
npcs.faction: The Orders of High Sorcery (Conclave of Wizards)
npcs.motivation: Wound: Frail body shattered in the Soulforge and lifelong resentment of Caramon's effortless strength. Lie: Power over life and death will silence his vulnerability. Want: Master Fistandantilus's arcane legacy. Need: Empathy for the weak (Bupu) and recognition of his brother's love.

secretsKnown.secret: Accepted the life-saving blood-pact of the ancient archmage Fistandantilus during the Test at Wayreth.
Murdered the illusory projection of his twin brother Caramon in the final chamber of the Test.

leverage.vulnerability: Crippling paroxysms of blood-coughing; genuine tenderness toward downtrodden outcasts like Bupu.
leverage.bribe: Ancient spellbooks of Fistandantilus and arcane autonomy.

dialogueHooks: Spoken (whispered rasp): "Look upon me with your healthy eyes, brother, and tell me what I owe their mercy." | Subtext: Every breath I draw is bought with pain you cannot fathom.
Spoken: "Shirak."

relationships.notes: Twin brother: fiercely resented yet indispensable shield.
Parasitic ancient soul sharing his mind.
Gentle compassion for the gully dwarf girl in Xak Tsaroth.
Half-sister who respects his ruthless ambition.

npcs.name: Caramon Majere
npcs.role: Veteran Heavy Warrior & Twin Guardian
npcs.faction: The Heroes of the Lance & Whitestone Vanguard
npcs.motivation: Wound: Witnessing Raistlin's broken body at Wayreth and his own repressed horror at what he saw in the Test mirror. Lie: If he just hovers closer, he can save Raistlin's soul. Want: Protect Raistlin and win Tika's heart. Need: Stand as his own man even when Raistlin walks into the dark.

secretsKnown.secret: Represses the memory of watching Raistlin incinerate his illusion inside the Chamber of the Test.
